harmonization_rule: YRBSS sex recoded to KYRBS convention: 1=male, 2=female.
Age category converted to approximate month age: 12-18 years as 144-216 months.
YRBSS grades 9/10/11/12 mapped to KYRBS high-school grade 4/5/6/6.
YRBSS high-school sample coded as 일반계고 where grade is 9-12.
School grades A-F mapped to 1-5; none/not sure set missing.
Housing status mapped roughly to KYRBS residence categories.
Perceived weight mapped directly to 1-5.
CDC BMI percentile category: <5th, 5-<85th, 85-<95th, >=95th.
Weight intention retained as 1-4.
YRBSS lacks violence-related hospital treatment; physical fight frequency used only as proxy.
Sad/hopeless binary recoded to KYRBS 1=no, 2=yes.
YRBSS current mental health frequency used as closest mental-health frequency proxy, not loneliness.
Sleep hours reverse-mapped to sleep sufficiency proxy.
School-night sleep categories converted to minutes.
YRBSS social media frequency converted to approximate minutes; not equivalent to smartphone use minutes.
Past-30-day alcohol use days retained as ordinal 1-7.
Largest number of drinks retained as ordinal 1-8.
Binge-drinking days used as intoxication analogue.
Derived from current cigarette and electronic vapor product use.
Cigarette amount retained as ordinal 1-7.
Any selected lifetime/current illicit or nonmedical drug use recoded to 1=no, 2=yes.
60+ minutes physical activity days retained as ordinal 1-8.
No vigorous-specific item; total physical activity days used as proxy.
Muscle strengthening days retained as ordinal 1-8.
Breakfast days retained as ordinal 1-8.
Fruit frequency retained as ordinal 1-7.
Soda/pop frequency used as narrowed sweet-drink analogue.
Plain water frequency retained as ordinal 1-7.
